name: Stepper
description: Walk the user through steps one at a time; you can use numbers, dots, or bars as indicators, lay the flow out horizontally or vertically, and swap each step's content with a smooth transition.
interactionNotes: Clicking any indicator takes you straight to that step; in linear mode only the steps you have already reached are open. The back/next buttons mirror themselves in RTL, and on the last step the button becomes "Finish". The panel height also eases open between steps.

props.name: children
props.description: The steps; each inside a `<Step>` with a `title`, a `description`, and an optional `icon`.

props.name: step
props.description: If you want to own the current step yourself, pass this together with `onStepChange`; without it, the component starts from `initialStep`.

props.name: initialStep
props.description: The step shown first.

props.name: onStepChange
props.description: Called every time the step changes.

props.name: onFinalStepCompleted
props.description: When the last step is passed.

props.name: indicator
props.description: The shape of the indicators in horizontal layout; vertical always uses numbers.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Indicators above the content or in a rail beside it; below 520 pixels the rail collapses on its own.

props.name: transition
props.description: How content moves between steps; the height eases in every mode too.

props.name: linear
props.description: Linear navigation: you can only go back to steps you have already reached.

props.name: disableStepIndicators
props.description: Turns off clicking on the indicators.

props.name: renderStepIndicator
props.description: Render your own custom indicator.

props.name: showFooter
props.description: Whether the back/next buttons are shown.

props.name: backButtonText
props.description: Text of the back button; the default is Persian.

props.name: nextButtonText
props.description: Text of the next button.

props.name: completeButtonText
props.description: Text of the next button on the final step.

props.name: backButtonProps
props.description: Extra props for the back button, such as `disabled`.

props.name: nextButtonProps
props.description: Extra props for the next button.

props.name: completedContent
props.description: Content that takes the place of the steps; if omitted, the buttons collapse and only the checks remain.

props.name: theme
props.description: Palette for the frame and controls; you can also override the colors from outside with the `--stepper-*` variables.

props.name: accentColor
props.description: Color of completed steps, the progress bar, and the next button; the text color on top is derived automatically from the color's lightness.

props.name: frame
props.description: The glass frame around the stepper.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner roundness of the frame, in pixels.

props.name: width
props.description: Maximum width of the stepper.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class for the root.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline style for the root.

tips: If it is a real form, turn on `linear`; that way the user cannot jump from step 2 to 4, and only the steps they have reached are open.
On mobile the layout becomes vertical and compact on its own; you do not need to write a media query.
Provide `completedContent` so a finish screen takes the place of the steps; otherwise only the checks and indicators remain.
Got several steppers one after another? Just change each one's `initialStep`; to sync with outside state, pass `step` and `onStepChange` as well.
